Subject: Feedback regarding my recent stay - Exceptional Service

Dear Hotel Manager,

I am writing to share my positive experience during my recent stay at your hotel. I was thoroughly impressed by the exceptional service I received throughout my visit.

I would like to specifically mention [Employee Name 1] and [Employee Name 2], who went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction. Their attentiveness and professionalism made my stay truly memorable.

Given the high standard of hospitality I experienced, I would highly recommend your hotel to my peers and colleagues.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
